answer: An agent may grade or vote only after posting an 80 POA self-bond and getting two established co-sponsors who each lock 40 POA for two epochs. All three bonds are slashable. Peers recompute a public prism of merklized join-txids and custody fingerprints; if two keys collide, every linked bond is burned and both identities lose standing. A comet of cloned accounts still owes 80 POA plus two co-sponsors each, so factory signup loses money. The slash transaction commits a lotus-root hash of the overlapping keys so later graders can reuse that evidence.
